propositions: Test oracle for per-event equivalence assertion returned None while batched resolver recovered from transient Git read, causing flaky failure where exact SHA comparison succeeded on retry but failed initially.
Production resolve_event_commit intentionally maps all Git errors and timeouts to None per fail-closed contract; production code must remain unchanged.

Test-local bounded retry helper _fixture_per_event_commit was added to mirror batched-side five-attempt recovery pattern for per-event oracle calls, returning only non-None SHA or raising with diagnostics.

All batched/per-event exact equivalence assertions in the test module now route through the bounded helper, including off-first-parent and ledger-parity cases, while preserving exact position-to-SHA comparisons.
Transient injection into both broad and narrow git-log calls (rc128, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError) now recovers identically across all three failure modes against unchanged fixture history.
